Title: Especialista Inteligencia Artificial

Diseñar e implementar agentes, copilots y experiencias conversacionales utilizando plataformas como Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI y frameworks de desarrollo especializados. Construir automatizaciones inteligentes integrando modelos de IA Generativa, APIs de LLMs, herramientas de Document AI y procesos de negocio. Integrar soluciones de IA con APIs, bases de conocimiento, vector stores y sistemas corporativos, asegurando una correcta comunicación entre plataformas. Aplicar técnicas de Prompt Engineering, RAG y orquestación de agentes para mejorar la precisión, contexto y desempeño de las soluciones. Ejecutar pruebas funcionales y de desempeño, identificar oportunidades de optimización y participar en la estabilización de modelos y agentes en producción. Explorar nuevas tecnologías, frameworks y tendencias de Inteligencia Artificial, proponiendo alternativas que puedan generar valor para el negocio. Perfil Ingeniería en Tecnologías de Información, Ciencias Computacionales, Software, Inteligencia Artificial, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Electrónica o carrera afín. 0 a 2 años de experiencia desarrollando soluciones relacionadas con Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning o desarrollo de software. También consideramos recién egresados con proyectos demostrables a través de GitHub, proyectos académicos, hackathons, prácticas profesionales, open source o proyectos personales. Inglés intermedio–avanzado. Conocimientos técnicos Python aplicado al desarrollo de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial. Fundamentos de Machine Learning, Deep Learning y NLP. IA Generativa, LLMs y Prompt Engineering. Desarrollo y orquestación de agentes de IA. Integración y consumo de APIs de LLMs. Técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Frameworks como PyTorch, LangChain, Semantic Kernel o similares. Plataformas de IA como Azure AI y Microsoft Copilot Studio. Conocimientos de Docker y CI/CD. Uso de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA como GitHub Copilot. Será un plus Contar con un portafolio de proyectos o GitHub donde podamos conocer soluciones que hayas desarrollado. Haber integrado APIs de OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude u otros modelos de lenguaje. Experiencia construyendo chatbots, agentes, copilots o automatizaciones con IA. Certificaciones relacionadas con Azure AI, Machine Learning, Copilot Studio o frameworks de Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos personas con curiosidad, capacidad para aprender rápidamente y muchas ganas de construir, experimentar y llevar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial a producción . Si quieres desarrollar tecnología que impacte directamente en nuestros clientes, socios y operación, H-E-B es tu lugar. En H-E-B México promovemos una cultura de diversidad, equidad e inclusión , donde todas las personas tienen las mismas oportunidades para desarrollarse y crecer. Nuestros procesos de selección se llevan a cabo con base en las competencias, experiencia y potencial de cada persona , sin distinción por género, edad, origen, condición, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra característica personal. Creemos que diferentes perspectivas, experiencias y formas de pensar nos hacen mejores y nos permiten seguir construyendo un lugar donde todas las personas puedan ser, pertenecer y aportar lo mejor de sí mismas .

Title: Data & AI/ML Engineer
Description: About Mindtech Mindtech is your gateway to exciting and impactful tech projects. We specialize in end-to-end software outsourcing, linking Latin American talent with global opportunities. Our fast, cost-effective approach ensures that our clients receive exceptional service and innovative solutions. With a diverse team of over 70 skilled professionals across Latin America and the US, we are committed to delivering software that drives success. About the role Buscamos un Data & AI/ML Engineer con experiencia en GCP, Inteligencia Artificial Generativa y desarrollo de agentes de IA, para diseñar e implementar soluciones de automatización en una empresa líder del sector de entretenimiento. El rol estará enfocado en desarrollar agentes inteligentes para optimizar procesos de compras, cadena de suministro y operaciones internas, integrándose con sistemas empresariales existentes. Buscamos un perfil muy proactivo, autónomo y resolutivo, capaz de identificar oportunidades, proponer soluciones y llevarlas a la práctica. Requirements Experiencia comprobable en desarrollo e implementación de agentes de IA. Conocimiento sólido de Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Gemini y Vertex AI. Experiencia con frameworks de agentes, preferentemente LangGraph o LangChain. Conocimiento de LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering e integraciones mediante APIs. Experiencia implementando modelos de IA tanto en la nube como on-premise. Conocimiento de Python (deseable, no excluyente). Experiencia integrando soluciones de IA con sistemas empresariales (ERP, SAP, Salesforce u otros). Inglés intermedio (B1). Perfil altamente proactivo, curioso, autónomo y orientado a resultados. Disponibilidad para trabajar de lunes a viernes, presencialmente en Monterrey. Responsibilities Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar agentes de IA para automatizar procesos de negocio. Construir soluciones utilizando GCP, Gemini, LangGraph y otras tecnologías de IA. Implementar modelos de IA en entornos cloud y on-premise, considerando costos, seguridad y rendimiento. Integrar agentes con sistemas empresariales, APIs y fuentes de datos existentes. Evaluar y mejorar agentes y soluciones de IA ya desarrollados. Colaborar con equipos de IT y negocio para identificar oportunidades y transformar necesidades en soluciones técnicas. Proponer mejoras y nuevas iniciativas de automatización de manera proactiva. We offer Modalidad 100% presencial en Monterrey Salario en USD. Programa de referidos. Proyecto inicial de 6 meses, con posibilidad de extensión. Participación en proyectos innovadores de IA con impacto real en el negocio. Hardware proporcionado por el cliente según los requerimientos técnicos.

Title: Pricing Specialist
Industries: Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing and Industrial Machinery Manufacturing
Description: We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions. What You Will Experience In This Position Join a multifaceted Global Pricing team that is on a digital pricing transformation journey. Develop and implement price action on price realization forecasting models to realize impact on pricing changes on revenue. Implement price management activities on modified quote pricing and special price agreements to collect value of our product portfolio offerings. Collaborate within business segment to recommend pricing strategies and models based upon current business and driving global dynamics. Perform product and customer profitability analytics through effective price action on customer accounts. Develop data analytics, including target price guidance logic, data-driven recommendation of delegation of authority thresholds, regional price variability recommendations, competitive indexing, ship-and-debit claims impact analytics, price waterfall models and cost-to-serve analysis. Monitor price performance metrics and perform periodic price analysis for product lines, pricing, customers. Implement various pricing strategies on global environment, including global contracts, price leader vs price follower, mature growth market vs penetration growth market strategy. You Have Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance or Economics required 2+ years’ experience analyzing data in pricing, sales, finance, marketing area Excellent digital literacy, including the ability to work optimally in Microsoft Office (specially Excell). Experience with PriceFx, Tacton, JDE, M3 and/or SAP preferred Java, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce will be a plus Ability to facilitate meetings and negotiate solutions with individuals that may have differing agendas and strong opinions Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and build positive working relationships We Have A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation. Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com. Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being: Innovative & adaptable Dedicated to absolute integrity Focused on the customer first Respectful and team oriented Optimistic and energizing Accountable for performance Benefits to support the lives of our employees At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

Title: Consultant - Procurement & Supply Chain
Industries: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing, Computers and Electronics Manufacturing, and Business Consulting and Services
Description: Who You'll Work With Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact You will play an active role in problem solving for clients including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analyses, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. As part of our two-year Operations Excellence Program (OEP), you will work on client engagements in the same way as any other McKinsey consultant. You will gain leading edge operations and consulting skills, primarily through on-the-job coaching which will be complemented by the OEP’s structured capability-building program. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a junior practice specialist on multiple client engagements and work with several colleagues and clients in a range of industry and operations service lines. You will acquire the necessary knowledge and expertise to help companies achieve excellence in their operations. Along with other members of the OEP community, you will dedicate many days to functional training and knowledge development under the leadership of our operations experts. You will follow a curriculum based on operations excellence themes and will receive advanced training in specific areas of operations. Additionally, you will engage with our clients to create new strategies across a wide range of projects, from automation to mine optimization to predictive maintenance and more. You will not only expand our current analytics capabilities but will help architect new strategies and applications within a dynamic innovative organization. Upon completion of the program, successful consultants will join our global group of leading experts in operational excellence. We already have OEP graduates working at all levels of the firm, from associate to partner. Your Qualifications and Skills Bachelor's degree in engineering or business; Masters or other advanced degree preferred Professional experience in procurement and/or supply management of services, contracts and categories and/or product development in the basic materials, consumer packaged goods, chemicals, financial services, healthcare, high-tech, oil & gas and energy industries Passionate about operational excellence and driving transformational change in organizations Outstanding analytical and conceptual skills Initiative and creativity, working well both on your own as well as in a team Comfortable with extensive travel Business level language fluency skills, both verbally and written, in English and Spanish
